title: Boeing Had A Record Year. Then It Collapsed
source: Boeing and Airbus annual commercial-aircraft delivery totals, from company press releases compiled by Flight Global, Statista and Cirium industry tracking, 2010-2024. Boeing delivered a company-record 806 jets in 2018, then collapsed to 380 in 2019 after the 737 MAX was grounded worldwide (March 2019) and to just 157 in 2020 as COVID-19 hit travel demand. Airbus delivered a record 863 aircraft in 2019 and has out-delivered Boeing every year since 2019, reaching 766 deliveries in 2024 versus Boeing's 348. Figures are the manufacturers' own reported annual delivery counts.
